'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Hungarian Pride ban]]
**Despite the ban by the [[Hungary|Hungarian]] authorities, tens of thousands gather for the [[Budapest Pride]] march, defying [[Prime Minister of Hungary|Prime Minister]] [[Viktor Orbán]]'s legal threats against the event. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c23g02dl1z8o (BBC News)]

**The [[French government]] issues a decree banning [[smoking]] in several public spaces, near schools, and where children gather. However, [[electronic cigarette]]s are exempt from the ban. [https://apnews.com/article/france-smoking-ban-parks-beaches-cancer-5def355f3f68af0572b2e4dcced9756c (AP)]
